notes.title: LudoNarraCon is LIVE -- join us and other amazing developers & games!
notes.content:
LudoNarraCon 2020 is officially a go, and we're honored to be a part of it! ːgorkydanceː 

Starting now until April 27th, you can enjoy narrative indie games to the fullest, with sales, demos, panels, and other livestreams. Of course, we wouldn't want to miss out, so here's what you can expect from us:


A (whopping) 35% discount on Still There
A pre-recorded partial playthrough where we talk about design decisions and drop other such nuggets of would-be wisdom
For those unconvinced by ^ -- a playable demo of Still There!
Our own Daniele Giardini (Demigiant) will be joining 3 other talented developers to talk on the Emergent vs. Traditional Game Narratives panel on April 25th, 18:00 CEST, which will be streamed here.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/33df8b9611e2a9d56ba6fc49b2ddaf94150a9f50.jpg


The Demo

Who doesn't like a proper demo? We do. That's why you can try before you buy. Get a little slice of Karl's life by peeping the demo on Steam.

The Panel

As mentioned above, Daniele Giardini (Demigiant)  will be joining the developers of Star Dynasties, Football Drama, and In Other Waters on a panel discussing narrative in video games, more specifically the differences between traditional narrative and emergent narrative. Don't know what that means, exactly? Tune in and find out! April 25th, 18:00 CEST, right here. Hope to see you there ːgorkyxoxoː

The Sale

Like the other lovely exhibitors at LudoNarraCon, you can grab Still There on sale! In fact, on its deepest sale yet, a jaw-dropping and show-stopping 35% off! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/

notes.title: Still There digitally attending LudoNarraCon 2020!
notes.content:
Do you like narrative driven indie games? Do you like gaming conventions minus all the cramming and sweat? 

If your answer to these two questions was yes, then we have some good news for you:


Still There and GhostShark Games will be attending LudoNarraCon as an exhibitor and panelist!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/e08192d2f0de3c96ab4cbc92cbf1c0d44ae415b5.jpg


What is LudoNarraCon?

LudoNarraCon is a digital convention, hosted on Steam, set up by Fellow Traveller -- oh, and it's FREE to attend!

Here's what you can expect as an attendee:


Thought-provoking panels and discussions arround narrative games
Explore upcoming games with a strong focus on narrative through livestreams
Sales on all exhibitors' games (hey, that includes us!)
Demos of a bunch of different narrative games


Sounds cool! what are you doing?

We're going to be doing the following:


Our very own Daniele Giardini (Demigiant) will be talking on the Emergent Vs. Traditional Game Narratives panel.
There will be a demo of Still There available for those of you who haven't gotten around to play it yet.
We'll get a loop of cool footage going for you to watch on the Still There store page.
Still There will be on sale.


We're excited to attend this year's LudoNarraCon, and hope you'll join us -- we're gonna have a blast!

More info: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/group/33025617/view/1827838782002270091

notes.title: Still There is available now!
notes.content:
The stars have aligned and we are thrilled to announce that Still There is available today on Steam! We are so happy and proud to share this experience with all of you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/0e611083f7424e0df24969736660131fa83b7050.jpg
https://youtu.be/_1WS85PqAOU
Still There is more than a simple game to us – it has had a profound impact on our lives. It has been the fulfilment of a promise that was told to the child version of ourselves, and has been an important test of our own feelings.

It has required many compromises and struggles and has, without a doubt, left its mark on us. Parts of us will always be in the game, and players across the world will experience our most intimate selves while playing Still There.

We hope it will leave an impact on you too.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/decba077fb3aa296cc243e114d8e9df6edd11e2f.png
Beware: you might laugh, cry, question the meaning of life and really, really fancy some tasty Italian coffee... all at once!

Still There combines technical puzzles and space-station management with themes of grief and guilt; sprinkled with some dark humour and a wacky AI. How much are you willing to sacrifice to rescue yourself and your loved ones, and how far is far enough?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/

notes.title: Still There Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to let you know that Still There will be releasing on 20th November 2019 here on Steam! 

Are you ready to manage the Bento space-lighthouse and its monotone routines, and meet Gorky - the stations wacky AI? And (arguably) more importantly, are you ready to find out the truth about what happened to your character Karl all those years ago that lead him to live this solitary life to begin with? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/34f71d949d85e4b0a4275b2b2b09ddaf2e564213.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/

"Yes Captain, I'm ready!" - you say? Great! If you haven't already - wishlist Still There ahead of release and prepare for the ultimate indie roller-coaster mashup that will challenge your mind, tug on your heartstrings and make you question the fundamental questions in life and if you're Still There at all...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/ebbbd39b038190eb836f0e679f1fae57aaff580d.jpg

notes.title: New Games & Trailers on First Ever ‘Iceberg Ahead’ at Paris Games Week 2019!
notes.content:
Hello to our great community!

We are excited to share with you some big news - today we're publicly announcing a totally new initiative for us: Iceberg Ahead!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1137099/55f034b3fa000f7929f1f7bf08a67be03e64b6fb.jpg

Hosted by industry veteran Dan Maher (@MrPointyHead - Inside Xbox), the very first Iceberg Ahead will air next Tuesday, October 29th at 7 PM GMT/3 PM EDT on YouTube and is set to feature more than 10 of our upcoming indie titles - including;

 Railroad Corporation 
 Still There

& more!

Make sure to subscribe on our YouTube channel so you won't miss the premiere!

We hope you'll enjoy!

notes.title: Psychological Adventure Game ‘Still There’ Announced
notes.content:
Hello to our cool community!

We are thrilled to announce that Iceberg Interactive will be collaborating with GhostShark Games on new sci-fi psychological adventure game Still There. The game is scheduled for release in Fall 2019 for PC (Windows) and Nintendo Switch™.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35131894/0e611083f7424e0df24969736660131fa83b7050.jpg

You can sample the game’s atmospheric look and feel in this brand new trailer: https://youtu.be/733Fx_h8FIk
Every day is the same on the faraway Bento space-lighthouse - until a mysterious radio message breaks through. Evade the past, welcome oblivion, make the perfect Italian coffee. Still There is a psychological adventure game about grief, technical puzzles, wacky AIs and dark humour. How far is far enough?

About Still There

 Maintain your space lighthouse by solving brain-bending puzzles and completing your daily tasks. Urine may be involved.
 Respond to emergency situations, take vital decisions while you unravel the emotional story of Karl’s past. 
 Engage in hilarious conversations with Gorky, the station’s AI. 
 Confront complex issues, such as depression and grief, in the deeply immersive narrative. 
 Soak up the nostalgia with stunning retro graphics and visuals.


Get ready to help Karl on his space missions by wishlisting the game today.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/
